name: IEC up/down counter
summary: IEC counter whose mode inputs select counting up with + or down with -, drawn with M dependency.
description: An up/down counter is shown with a CTR qualifier and a clock input labelled with both counting directions, for example 2+ and 1- under mode control. A direction input produces M1 and M2 modes, so the same clock counts up in one mode and down in the other. Load and enable functions use further dependency labels.

Typical applications include position tracking from pulse inputs, reversible totalising and digital set-point adjustment. The drawing should identify the direction source and whether direction may change while clock pulses are present.
The symbol does not indicate how overflow or underflow is signalled beyond any CT= outputs shown. Check ripple clock or max/min outputs on the device.
readingNotes: Find the mode input that selects direction.
Check CT outputs for terminal counts in each direction.
drawingChecklist: Show both + and - functions with their mode numbers.
Show cascade outputs for multi-stage counters.
distinction: A single-direction CTR counter shows only + on its clock.
